title: Bergisel-Sprungschanze Innsbruck
highlights: Olympiaschanze und Wahrzeichen moderner Sportarchitektur, entworfen von Zaha Hadid
Schrägaufzug und Turmlift hinauf zum Schanzenturm mit Panoramarestaurant Bergisel Sky
Austragungsort des traditionellen Vierschanzentournee-Springens vor über 20.000 Fans
Spektakulärer Blick vom Schanzentisch über Innsbruck und die imposante Nordkette
kurzbeschreibung: The Bergisel-Sprungschanze designed by Zaha Hadid is a world-renowned masterpiece of sports architecture with a panoramic restaurant and far-reaching views.
beschreibung:
Sports Monument and Architectural Landmark

Perched high above the rooftops of Innsbruck, the Bergisel-Sprungschanze stands on historic ground. Designed by star architect Zaha Hadid, the ski jump facility merges a tower café, viewing platform, and inrun track into an elegant, sculptural unit.

Panoramic Restaurant Bergisel Sky

An inclined lift and tower elevator transport visitors effortlessly up the ski jump tower. Inside the fully glazed Bergisel Sky restaurant and on the panoramic terrace, guests enjoy a breathtaking 360-degree vista over the Inntal and the Tyrolean mountains.
